name: Brace Now
flavor:
Shout a warning so one friend braces before the barrel rolls off the cart, the ladder slips, the drunk's fist lands, or the horse sidesteps into them. They take the hit, but they take it ready.

Not enough to stop the barrel, or to warn more than one person at a time.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 2 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 1.
surge1_html: Reduce forced movement from that Action by 1 unit.
surge2_html: The target may move 1 unit toward you after the Action; self may move freely.

name: Keep Your Eyes Up
flavor:
Warn one friend of a thrown bottle, a snapping rope, a pickpocket's hand, or a trap plate just before it matters, and point out where it came from. They get the moment they need to flinch the right way.

Not enough to warn a room or to see what you have not noticed yourself.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature from a source you detect, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 to its targeted Defense against that attack.
surge1_html: Reveal the attacker's occupied space to the protected target.
surge2_html: The target becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn if the attack misses.

name: Change the Approach
flavor:
Call one friend a step out of trouble as it comes to them: out of a drunk's reach, off the plank before the dock worker shoves past, away from the horse that has just noticed them. They move before the other side gets the chance.

Not enough to move someone who will not listen, or more than one person.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to the target. Response (unopposed): Move the target 1 unit along a clear path without triggering that enemy's movement Reactions.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: The target gains +1 Fortitude against that enemy until the start of your next turn.

name: Close the Ranks
flavor:
Grab one friend who is about to be dragged: swept by a crowd, pulled toward the edge by a snagged rope, carried by a river current. Keep them with you and on their feet.

Not enough to hold against a cart or a bolting horse.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would push or pull the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that movement by 2 units and grant +1 Fortitude against the triggering Action.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit toward another willing creature after the Action.
surge2_html: Reduce the Action's Damage to the target by 1.

name: Rally Through the Breach
flavor:
When the punch misses, the trap snaps shut on nothing, or the tossed bottle shatters on the wall, use the moment: get one shaken friend moving toward the spot you called and put their nerve back.

Not enough to steady more than one person.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units of you and 1 unit of your rally point.
effect_html: Trigger: An enemy Action misses that creature. Response (unopposed): Make it Rallied until the start of your next turn; it may move 1 unit toward the rally point.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary morale-based Success Die penalty on the target until the start of your next turn.

name: Not While I Stand
flavor:
Step between one friend and what is coming: the thrown stone, the kick, the falling beam. You take some of it or all of it. Soften the hit for yourself the same way.

Not enough to shield more than one person, or stop something heavier than a man can stand under.
target_html: Self or an adjacent willing ally.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 1; if protecting an ally, you may take any remaining Damage in its place.
surge1_html: Resist 1 unit of forced movement from the triggering Action.
surge2_html: Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties on yourself until the start of your next turn.

name: Let Them See You Answer
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy misses you or an adjacent ally with an Action. Response: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: After a hit, yourself or the missed ally may move 1 unit toward the target.
surge2_html: Make yourself or the missed ally Rallied until the start of your next turn.

name: The Line Moves With Us
flavor:
When something big comes at the room, move yourself and one friend out of its path together: the scaffold toppling, the cart coming through the stall, the crowd breaking into a stampede, the wave over the rail. You go the same way at the same moment.

Not enough to move more than two people or outrun what is already on top of you.
target_html: Self and one willing ally within 2 units, or self alone.
effect_html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including at least one target. Response (unopposed): Each target moves 1 unit; recheck the area afterward.
surge1_html: One target moves 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: Each target still in the area reduces that Action's Damage by 1.

name: No Panic, Just Orders
flavor:
Cut the panic out of one person the moment it takes hold: the ferryman freezing mid-river, the guard about to run from a fire, the witness crumbling under a threat. They hear your voice and get back to work, and threats bounce off for now.

Not enough to calm a crowd or undo what frightened them.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction imposes an ordinary mental or morale Condition on the target. Response (unopposed): Suppress that Condition until the start of your next turn; the target gains +1 Composure for that duration.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit toward you; self moves freely.
surge2_html: The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

name: The Promise Holds
flavor:
Keep a badly hurt friend from taking the next blow: the kick from the man standing over them, the rubble coming down, the second fall on a bad leg. You promised they would come home, and the promise takes the worst of it.

Not enough to close the wound, or to protect someone who was not already hurt.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would cause Damage to the target while it has at least one Core Wound. Response (unopposed): Reduce the Damage by 2, without changing existing Wounds.
surge1_html: The target becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Suppress one non-Critical Wound Condition's numerical penalties on the target until the start of your next turn.

name: Return the Challenge
target_html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy deals Damage to you with a melee Action. Response: After its Damage, on success deal 2 weapon Damage.
surge1_html: On a hit, push the enemy 1 unit away from an adjacent ally, or from yourself.
surge2_html: Make yourself or one willing ally within 3 units Rallied until the start of your next turn.

name: The Palm Against the Omen
flavor:
Catch a small harm as it falls: a stumble on the stair, a scald from the pot, a pup's bite, a thrown mug, a loose stone from the wall. The friend who takes it walks away with a bruise instead of a wound.

Not enough to turn a blade or a falling beam.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 2 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 1.
surge1_html: The target also resists 1 unit of forced movement from that Action.
surge2_html: Suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by that Action until the start of your next turn.

name: The Needle Returns
target_html: One enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy misses you with an Action. Response: On success, deal 1 Necrotic Damage.
surge1_html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: On a hit, suppress 1 point of its ordinary accuracy bonuses until the start of your next turn.

name: The Uncrossed Circle
flavor: Whoever stands inside a mark you laid is a hard target: the thrown bottle misses, the dog's lunge falls short, the guard's grab closes on air, the stone from the crowd goes wide. Only inside the circle.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature while it stands within 1 unit of one of your Rite anchors, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 to its targeted Defense against that attack.
surge1_html: The creature resists up to 2 units of forced movement from the attack.
surge2_html: Reduce its Damage by 1 if it hits.

name: A Curse Given Back
flavor:
When a charm settles on you, shrug it off and send it home: the glamour fades, the sleep does not take, the fear lifts, and the one who sent it goes pale and shaky for the scene.

Not enough to break the working for good or protect anyone but yourself.
target_html: One enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy imposes an ordinary magical Condition on you. Response: On success, suppress that Condition on yourself until the start of your next turn and give the enemy -1 Harmony for the same duration.
surge1_html: On a hit, the enemy is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Deal 1 Necrotic Damage on a hit.

name: The Page Turns Early
flavor: Read the next page a heartbeat early and pull a friend one step clear of the collapsing scaffold, the spreading fire, the net dropped from the rafters, the cart jumping the curb, the wave over the rail.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: A detected enemy declares an area Action including the target. Response (unopposed): Move the target 1 unit; recheck the area afterward.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: If still affected, give the target +1 to the targeted Defense against that Action.

name: The Sigil Holds
flavor:
Keep one person on their feet when the ground tries to take them: a rope snapping, ice underfoot, a river current, a crowd surge, a rearing horse, a trapdoor dropping open. They stay where they stood.

Not enough to hold a cart or save someone already falling.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would force the target to move or make it Prone. Response (unopposed): Reduce forced movement by 2 units and prevent that Prone effect.
surge1_html: Suppress an ordinary Poison penalty on the target until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: Reduce the Action's Damage to the target by 1.

name: The Unspent Candle
flavor: Snuff a rite you have laid and spend it to take the edge off a blow: the beam that falls on a friend, the trap's blade, the kick of a mule, the fall from the loft. They are hurt less than they should be.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): End one of your Rites to reduce that Damage by 2. Ending it this way cannot resolve an Echo.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit after the Action.
surge2_html: Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties on the target until the start of your next turn.

name: The Gate Refuses the Storm
flavor:
Stand one person through what should flatten them: a wall coming down, a wave over the deck, the edge of a stampede, a fall from the hayloft, a cart that does not stop. They come up bruised and still standing where they were. One friend beside them gets some of the same.

Not enough to shelter a crowd or stop the wall from falling.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 2 and resist 1 unit of forced movement from the Action.
surge1_html: Resist 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: An adjacent willing creature also reduces Damage from the same Action by 1.

name: The Answer Hidden in the Spread
flavor:
Read the spread a second time and a friend gets another try at a moment they fumbled: the lockpick that slipped, the jump that fell short, the toast that landed wrong, the knot tied in the wrong order. They must take the second answer.

Not enough to undo what has already happened or help more than one.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The target rolls a Combat Card, before spending Surges. Response (unopposed): It may reroll one die and must use the new result, then recalculate its Success Die and generated Surges.
surge1_html: It may ignore one ordinary -1 Success Die penalty on that card.
surge2_html: After that card, the target may move 1 unit. No additional Action is granted.

name: The Seal Beneath the Scar
flavor:
When a friend takes a bad hurt, a fall from the cliff, a bear's claw, a hand crushed under the cart, seal the pain so they can still climb, run, or hold on. The hurt is real and it stays.

Not enough to mend anything or hold off the pain past the scene.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction fills a Core Wound on the target. Response (unopposed): After recording the Wound, suppress that new Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn if non-Critical. The Wound remains.
surge1_html: The target resists 1 unit of any remaining forced movement from that Action.
surge2_html: It gains +1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

name: The Last Coin Is Not Yours
flavor:
When someone breaks a mark you laid, scuffs the circle, tears down the charm, snuffs the candle, the breaking costs them: they sicken, go slow, lose the thread of what they were doing. The mark stays broken.

Not enough to kill or restore what they ruined.
target_html: One enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy ends one of your Rites with an Action. Response: On success, deal 2 Necrotic Damage after that Action; the Rite remains ended.
surge1_html: On a hit, suppress one ordinary magical Movement bonus on the enemy until the start of your next turn, up to 1 unit.
surge2_html: On a hit, it is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

name: Little Sentinel, Warn Me
flavor:
A chirp before the pickpocket's hand reaches your purse, a tug at the sleeve before a tile falls from the eaves, a hiss when the ground ahead is a snare, or a warning at the door before a knock lands. One small danger, seen one moment early.

Not enough to watch a whole street or warn you of what is still around the corner.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 2 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature from a source you detect, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 to its targeted Defense against the attack.
surge1_html: Reveal the attacker's occupied space to the target.
surge2_html: After the attack, the target may move 1 unit.

name: Mote of Mercy, Turn the Edge
flavor:
Take the edge off a punch in a tavern, soften a fall down a short flight of stairs, blunt a nail through a boot, or keep a kitchen scald from blistering. One hurt made smaller.

Not enough to stop a fall from a roof, catch an arrow, or close a wound already made.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 1; this prevents harm rather than healing any injury.
surge1_html: The target resists 1 unit of forced movement from that Action.
surge2_html: Reduce the Damage by 1 more.

name: Hunting Brother, Answer the Bite
target_html: One enemy within 2 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy damages you with a melee Action. Response: After that Damage, on success deal 1 Slashing Damage.
surge1_html: After a hit, pull the target 1 unit.
surge2_html: Deal +1 Slashing Damage.

name: Pack Mother, Pull Them Clear
flavor:
Pull a friend out from under a falling scaffold, drag someone back from a cart that will not stop, yank a child clear of a snapped rope, or haul a companion out of a gas-filled cellar. One person moved out of harm's path.

Not enough to move a group, carry anyone far, or stop what was falling.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including the target. Response (unopposed): Move it 1 unit along a clear path, then recheck the area.
surge1_html: Increase movement by 1 unit.
surge2_html: If still affected, grant +1 to its targeted Defense against that Action.

name: White Shroud, Swallow the Hex
flavor:
Keep a charm from taking hold of a friend's mind, hold a hex off long enough to leave the house, keep a witch's mark from spreading for the scene, or let someone shrug off a cursed drink. The shroud takes the spell first.

Not enough to lift a curse already set, protect a group, or stop poison or a blade.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction imposes an ordinary magical Condition on the target. Response (unopposed): Suppress that Condition until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: The target gains +1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

name: Unseen Guest, Undo Their Certainty
flavor:
Be a step to one side when a punch is thrown in a tavern, slip clear of a grab in a crowd, leave a guard pointing at the place you stood, or spoil a card sharp's throw at the moment they commit. One person's certainty, pulled out from under them.

Not enough to vanish, cross a room, or make anyone forget your face.
target_html: One detected enemy within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy declares a single-target Action against you, before rolling. Response: On success, impose -1 on its Success Die and move yourself 1 unit before its roll; recheck range.
surge1_html: On a hit, its target space provides concealment afterward until the start of your next turn.
surge2_html: On a hit, the enemy is Distracted after the Action until the start of your next turn.

name: Stone Brother, Take the Weight
flavor:
Stand under a falling sack of grain, hold your footing when a crowd surges, keep a friend upright when a horse barges past, or take a shove on a ledge without going over. Stone shoulders for one blow.

Not enough to stand under a collapsing wall, stop a cart, or hold against more than one push.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal physical Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 1 and resist up to 2 units of forced movement from the same Action.
surge1_html: Prevent the Action's ordinary Prone effect.
surge2_html: Reduce its Damage by 1 more.

name: River King, Divide the Torrent
flavor:
Walk a friend through a burning stable, hold a hand in forge fire for a moment, stand on an open hilltop in a lightning storm, pull someone out of ice water without the cold taking them, or wash acid out of a wound before it bites. The river stands between one person and the element.

Not enough to shelter a group, put out the fire, or outlast the whole storm.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Fire, Cold, Lightning or Acid Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 2 and suppress one ordinary Burning or Poison Condition imposed by that Action until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: The target may move 1 unit after the Action.
surge2_html: An adjacent willing creature also reduces Damage from that same Action by 1.

name: Thunder Sister, Answer the Intrusion
flavor:
Give a thief a jolt and a shove when they step up to your campfire uninvited, knock a drunk back from a friend's table, throw a door open against whoever leaned on it, or send a wolf yelping away from the picket line. The first one through gets the thunder.

Not enough to ward a whole camp, hurt anyone badly, or hold a door against a crowd.
target_html: One enemy within 5 units.
effect_html: Trigger: The enemy finishes voluntary movement adjacent to you or an ally within 2 units. Response: On success, deal 1 Lightning Damage and push it 1 unit.
surge1_html: Push it 1 additional unit.
surge2_html: Also attack a second enemy within 1 unit of the first with the same roll for 1 Lightning Damage.

name: Elder Shield, Remember the Watch
flavor:
Take the worst of a fall from a roof, walk a friend through a hail of stones, keep someone standing through a beating long enough to be dragged out, or let a hurt companion climb a cliff with their teeth set. The old ones take the hurt and the fear of it.

Not enough to mend anything, protect a group, or stop a wound from being a wound afterward.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 2. The target gains +1 Composure against pain until the start of your next turn.
surge1_html: After the Action, the target may move 1 unit toward you; self moves freely.
surge2_html: Suppress one non-Critical Wound Condition's numerical penalties on the target until the start of your next turn.

name: Laughing Envoy, Change the Door
flavor:
Move a friend across a room before a thrown bottle lands, put a companion on the far side of a doorway as it slams, step a child out of a horse's path, or pull someone off a collapsing stair onto solid floor. Two paces, through the Court's door, before the blow falls.

Not enough to pass through a wall, cross a street, or move anyone who does not want to go.
target_html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.
effect_html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Move it up to 2 units along a clear path; it gains +1 Fortitude against that attack. Recheck target validity afterward.
surge1_html: Ignore difficult terrain during the movement.
surge2_html: Swap it with another willing creature adjacent to its starting space instead; the new legal target receives the Fortitude bonus.
